scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --test tests/active-scoreboard.test.ts tests/answer-submission.test.ts tests/config.test.ts tests/login.test.ts tests/match-time.test.ts tests/sessions.test.ts
scripts.test:docker: cd .. && docker compose -f compose.backend.yml --env-file backend/.env --profile tools run --rm tools sh -c 'node --import tsx --input-type=module -e "import { readConfig } from \"./src/config.ts\"; import { connectPostgres } from \"./src/persistence/postgres.ts\"; const url = process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL; if (!url) throw new Error(\"TEST_DATABASE_URL is required for full regression\"); const config = readConfig({ DATABASE_URL: url }).database; if (!config.database.endsWith(\"_test\")) throw new Error(\"TEST_DATABASE_URL must name a *_test database\"); const pool = connectPostgres(config); try { const { rows } = await pool.query(\"SELECT current_database() AS name\"); if (rows[0]?.name !== config.database) throw new Error(\"Connected database does not match TEST_DATABASE_URL\"); console.log(\"Verified test database:\", rows[0].name); } finally { await pool.end(); }" && npm test'
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
